title: WenshuCheckReport
description: Version 1.1.0 report of rule-based checks over the PA-06 PDF evidence model. Findings carry stable codes, page/node locations and numeric basis only; document content is never echoed. Adds manualChecks (PA-08 honesty gate): judgments the rules cannot determine automatically are deferred to explicit human review with numeric evidence, never disguised as automatic passes. Additive over frozen 1.0.0.

evidenceSha256.description: SHA-256 of the PDF bytes the checked evidence was extracted from.

rules.description: Rule ids actually executed (per-rule rollback is expressed by absence here).

manualChecks.description: Explicit human-review items for judgments that have no deterministic or template-traceable basis (e.g. sparse-page density, heading keep-with-next gray zone). Presence of a manual check is never a pass and never a finding.

code.description: Stable review code for the deferred judgment (P1_* review codes land in PA-08~10).

nodeRef.description: Deterministic node locator, same vocabulary as Finding.nodeRef.

reason.description: Static explanation of why automatic determination is impossible (template silence, registered approximation). Static text only, never document content.

metrics.description: Numeric evidence for the human reviewer (e.g. coverageRatio, followingLinesOnPage, template threshold). Named values only, never text.

relatedNodeRef.description: Second party for paired review items.

code.description: Stable issue code; P0_* are blocking, P1_* are warnings (P1 rules land in PA-08~10).

nodeRef.description: Deterministic node locator: run:<readingOrder>, figure:<pageIndex>:<mcid>, page:<index>, or a document block path like /blocks/3.

metrics.description: Numeric evidence for the finding (e.g. overflowPt, overlapAreaPt2, expectedLength). Named values only, never text.

relatedNodeRef.description: Second party for pairwise findings (e.g. overlap).
